paite: Liangvaite kiang a tanchinhoih gen ding a TOUPA'N thau ahon nilh ziak in ka tung ah Toupa PATHIAN kha a-om; ama'n lungtang khasiate tuam ding, salte kiang a pawtna thu leh saltangte kiang a tanin honna thu gen ding.
heading: Hotkhiakna Thu Thak Kipahhuai
english: The Lord Yahweh’s Spirit is on me, because Yahweh has anointed me to preach good news to the humble. He has sent me to bind up the broken hearted, to proclaim liberty to the captives and release to those who are bound,

paite: TOUPA lungkim kum thu leh i Pathian phulak ni thugen ding bang, lungkhamte lungmuan ding bang,
english: to proclaim the year of Yahweh’s favor and the day of vengeance of our God, to comfort all who mourn,

paite: Vut tang a pakkhigui bang, lungkham tang a nopna thau bang, nguina kha tang a phatna puansilh bang akiang ua piak ding, Zion a lungkham a omte a ding a seh ding bang in ahon sawl ahi. Amah pahtawi a a-omna ding in, diktatna sing TOUPA suante chih, ahihtheihna ding un.
english: to provide for those who mourn in Zion, to give to them a garland for ashes, the oil of joy for mourning, the garment of praise for the spirit of heaviness, that they may be called trees of righteousness, the planting of Yahweh, that he may be glorified.

paite: Mun lui sesate alem nawn ding ua, tuma a khua sesate adingh hoihsak nawn ding ua, khopi sesa, suan tampi gamnate, abawlhoih nawn ding uh.
english: They will rebuild the old ruins. They will raise up the former devastated places. They will repair the ruined cities that have been devastated for many generations.

paite: Gamdang mite'n dinsa in na ganhonte uh avak ding ua, theih ngei louh mite na leiletmi ding un leh na grepgui uh kemmi ding in a-om ding uh.
english: Strangers will stand and feed your flocks. Foreigners will work your fields and your vineyards.

paite: Nou bel, TOUPA siampute, chih a loh in na om ding uh; mite'n i Pathian nasem mite ahon chi ding uh. Namte sum na ne ding ua, athupina uh na suang ding uh.
english: But you will be called Yahweh’s priests. Men will call you the servants of our God. You will eat the wealth of the nations. You will boast in their glory.

paite: Na zahlakna gun uh aleh nih na mu ding ua; na zum gun un na tantuan uah nuamsa in la na sa ding uh; huaiziak in na gam uah azahnih na luah ding ua; tangtawn nopsakna nou a ahi ding.
english: Instead of your shame you will have double. Instead of dishonor, they will rejoice in their portion. Therefore in their land they will possess double. Everlasting joy will be to them.

paite: Kei TOUPA'N vaihawmna dik ka deih a, thulim loutak a hiamgam zaw ka hua hi; huchi in amau ka thukna chihtak ngial in akiang uah ka pe ding a, akiang uah tangtawn thu leng ka khung ding.
english: “For I, Yahweh, love justice. I hate robbery and iniquity. I will give them their reward in truth and I will make an everlasting covenant with them.

paite: Huchi in asuante uh nam chih lak a theih ahi ding ua, atate uh michih lak a theih ahi ding uh; amau mute'n TOUPA vualzawl chi ahi uh chih athei ding uhi.
english: Their offspring will be known among the nations, and their offspring among the peoples. All who see them will acknowledge them, that they are the offspring which Yahweh has blessed.”

paite: TOUPA ah nakpitak in nuam ka sa ding a, ka hinna Pathian ah kipaktak in a-om ding. Mouneipa ding pakkhigui a akizep bang leh mou ding a kivatnate a akivat zel bang in, ama'n hotdamna puansilhte ahon silhsak a, diktatna puanaktual in ahon tuamta hi.
english: I will greatly rejoice in Yahweh! My soul will be joyful in my God, for he has clothed me with the garments of salvation. He has covered me with the robe of righteousness, as a bridegroom decks himself with a garland and as a bride adorns herself with her jewels.

paite: Leitung in athil dawn apawtsak bang leh, huan in asung a thil chinte adawnsak bang in, Toupa PATHIAN in diktatna leh phatna nam chih ma ah adawnkhesak ding ahi.
english: For as the earth produces its bud, and as the garden causes the things that are sown in it to spring up, so the Lord Yahweh will cause righteousness and praise to spring up before all the nations.
